name: YouTrack
desc: JetBrains project management and issue tracking for agile teams.

actions.name: create_issue
actions.description: Creates a new issue in a YouTrack project.

actions.name: get_issue
actions.description: Retrieves full details of an issue including all custom field values.

actions.name: search_issues
actions.description: Searches for issues using YouTrack query syntax. Returns flat rows for spreadsheets.

actions.name: update_issue
actions.description: Updates an existing issue - summary, description, or custom fields.

actions.name: apply_command
actions.description: Applies a YouTrack command to an issue (e.g. change state, assign, set sprint).

actions.name: add_tag_to_issue
actions.description: Adds an existing tag to an issue.

actions.name: remove_tag_from_issue
actions.description: Removes a tag from an issue.

actions.name: create_tag
actions.description: Creates a new tag in YouTrack.

actions.name: list_tags
actions.description: Lists all tags visible to the current user.

actions.name: upload_attachment
actions.description: Uploads one or more files as attachments to an existing issue.

actions.name: delete_attachment
actions.description: Deletes an attachment from an issue.

actions.name: download_attachment
actions.description: Downloads an attachment from an issue and returns it as a Base64-encoded string. Use this with the "Upload to Drive" or "Send Email" actions in your flow.

actions.name: get_issue_history
actions.description: Retrieves the full change history (activity log) for a specific issue.

actions.name: add_comment
actions.description: Adds a comment to an issue. Supports Markdown formatting.

actions.name: list_comments
actions.description: Lists all comments on an issue with author details and timestamps.

actions.name: add_user_to_team
actions.description: Adds a user as a direct member of a project team, giving them access to the project.

actions.name: link_issues
actions.description: Creates a relationship between two issues (e.g. "relates to", "depends on", "is duplicated by").

actions.name: list_attachments
actions.description: Lists all attachments on a specific issue with metadata (name, size, type).

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

triggers.name: new_issue
triggers.description: Triggers when a new issue is created in any project you can access.

triggers.name: updated_issue
triggers.description: Triggers when an existing issue is modified (summary, description, custom fields, etc.).
